# HTTP and HTTPS (`source_type: http`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Sends one request and reports the response time in milliseconds, or, with `json_path`, a number read from the JSON response.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- `ms`: response time in milliseconds
- with `json_path` set: no unit: the number extracted from the JSON response at json_path (booleans read as 1/0); unit as in the response

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | yes | string |  | URL |
| `method` | no | enum | `"GET"` | `GET`, `HEAD`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `OPTIONS` |
| `expected_status` | no | integer or array of integer | `200` | 100 to 599; items 100 to 599 |
| `timeout_ms` | no | integer | `5000` | 1 to 60000 |
| `headers` | no | object |  |  |
| `header_refs` | no | object |  | values are env var names on the agent host |
| `body_match` | no | string |  |  |
| `follow_redirects` | no | boolean | `true` |  |
| `verify_tls` | no | boolean | `true` |  |
| `json_path` | no | string |  | up to 256 characters |
| `client_cert_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `client_key_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `ca_cert_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |

## Rules

- `url` must be http or https and must not carry `user:pass@`. Put credentials in `header_refs`.
- `headers` are stored by Observer, so a header whose name looks like a credential is rejected there: Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie, X-Api-Key, Api-Key, Apikey, any name containing token, secret, password, passwd, auth or session, and any name ending in key. Map it in `header_refs` to an env var name on the agent host instead.
- A header name may not appear in both `headers` and `header_refs`.
- Mutual TLS: set `client_cert_ref` and `client_key_ref` together (env vars holding PEM text or a path to a PEM file). `ca_cert_ref` is optional.
- `expected_status` takes one code or a list. A different status reports `no_data` with an `unexpected_status:<code>` reason.
- `body_match` checks the first 4 KB of the body for a string.
- The `mtls_http` source type is a deprecated alias of `http`. Use `http` with the `*_ref` fields.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: http
source_config: {"url":"https://api.example.com/health","expected_status":200,"timeout_ms":5000}
```
